fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 12 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Halting Order
fusions.desc: Brings the ground down on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage to each. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Hobnail Stride
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pilgrim's Plating
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.
